transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well... it's the people at my apartment building. They've been... watching my comings and goings. Slipping notes about me to the office. Everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices on the doors, but... I know what they're doing. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
How long have you believed that the people in your apartment building are watching you?
...I don't know exactly. It's been a while. I guess... maybe about a year and a month. Give or take.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t?
No. I don't... I don't hear anything like that. Just the usual noises.
Do you believe anyone can prove these people are watching you?

...I don't know about proving it. Like I said, I just know they're watching my comings and goings. They slip those notes to the office... even if everybody else keeps telling me they're just regular door notices. I just... I know what they're doing.
Have you found it hard to keep your thoughts organized when you talk or think?

...I guess sometimes. When I try to explain things to people, it just... it doesn't always come out right. I'll start talking about the rent, and then... I don't know, the marina, or the choir robes. And the wires in the walls. And they just... they look at me like I skipped half the story. So I just... I don't talk much anymore.
Have you had a time when you felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep than usual?
No. I don't... I don't get like that. I'm just... tired. Most of the time.
Have you had any periods when you felt unusually depressed or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?

...Yeah. I guess so. It's just... most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. Like... like the day already went bad before I even get my feet on the floor. It's been like that for a while now. I just don't care about much anymore.
Do you ever have the feeling that your mood gets low, and only then do these beliefs about the apartment building become stronger?

...I guess. When I get real down like that... when I'm just sitting in the dark, not eating or answering the phone... that's when I know for sure. That's when I know the people in the building are watching me. Tracking me. Telling the office everything I do. It just... gets louder then, I guess.
Do these beliefs about the apartment building ever happen when your mood is not low?

...Yeah. I mean, there was a time... maybe for a few weeks, a while back. I was eating a little more. Waking up wasn't quite as... heavy. But they were still watching my door. I still knew they were reporting on me. That didn't stop.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was around?
...No. Not really. Just... my own thoughts, mostly.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when the paranoia was there even though your mood was not depressed?

...Yeah, I think I just said that. There was a spell... several weeks, I guess. I was eating a bit better. Waking up wasn't so... hopeless. But I still knew they were watching my door. Reporting on me. That part didn't go away.
Have you ever had a period of at least a week when you felt abnormally high or irritable and needed much less sleep than usual?
...No. I don't think so. I don't get... high like that. Just the opposite, mostly.
Have you ever had a head injury, seizure disorder, or another medical illness around the time these beliefs started?
...No. Never had anything like that. Just... regular sick sometimes, like a cold. But no head injuries or... seizures. Nothing like that.
Have you had times when your speech became so disorganized that other people had a hard time following what you meant?

...I guess. Sometimes. People look at me funny. Like I skipped half the story. I try to explain things... start talking about the rent, and then... the marina. The choir robes. The wires in the walls. They just... they don't follow. It makes sense to me, but... yeah. They have a hard time.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high or irritable for at least a week?
...No. I think you asked that already. I don't... I don't get high like that. Just... low. Mostly low.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being put into your mind, taken out of your mind, or heard as if they were not your own?
...No. I don't... I don't think so. They're just my thoughts. Nobody's putting them there. Just me.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the paranoia or odd beliefs were present even though you were not feeling depressed?

...Yeah. I guess there was a time. A few weeks, maybe. I was eating a little more... not waking up feeling so heavy and useless all the time. But... I still knew they were watching. The neighbors. Keeping an eye on my door... reporting on me. Even when I felt a little better, they were still doing it.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when you had these beliefs or other unusual experiences even though you were not feeling depressed?
...I think I just answered that. Yeah. A few weeks where I wasn't as low, but... they were still watching. Like I said.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when you had these unusual beliefs or other psychotic symptoms even though you were not feeling depressed?
...We just went over this. Yes. I wasn't depressed, but I still knew they were out there. I already told you.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt unusually energized or much less needed sleep than usual?
...No. Can't say I have. I don't really get bursts of energy like that. Mostly just... tired.
